About the Club

Every serve
starts with us

The Tennis Club, led by Shohratjanova Shirin, brings foreign students together on campus courts throughout the year — through a team competition, an individual tournament, and regular training on the South Campus hard courts.

Foreign Student Team
Competition

We compete,
we grow

01

Team Competition

November

Teams are formed from the best players among foreign students and compete against Chinese teams. Last year our team placed 5th — hopefully we'll do better this year.

02

Individual Tournament

Late May

Singles and doubles matches are organised instead of team events. Both the university's top players and complete beginners are welcome to take part.

Training

Discipline on
the hard courts

Every year before the competition, practice sessions are arranged several times a week on the South Campus hard courts for those who want to take part.

Closer to the tournament, qualifying rounds are held to select the best players. Anyone who practices with discipline will surely achieve success one day.
